title: Subsets, combinations, permutations
learn: choose / explore / un-choose template, decision tree, handling duplicates (sort + skip), complexity O(2ⁿ)/O(n!)
hook: Subsets, Permutations, Combination Sum and Generate Parentheses are staples of every interview list, and they're all the same three lines: choose, explore, un-choose.

explain.prompt: Explain the backtracking template using Subsets or Permutations: the decision tree, the choose/explore/un-choose steps, and the complexity.
keyPoints: build answers one decision at a time; the decisions form a tree and DFS walks it
choose (append), explore (recurse), un-choose (pop) so the next branch starts clean
subsets: pick or skip each element → 2ⁿ results, O(n·2ⁿ)
permutations: any unused element at each position → n! results, O(n·n!)
copy the path when recording; sort and skip equal values at the same depth to avoid duplicates
